tiers.name: `preserve_rng_state=False` (Backward Recompute Uses Advanced Philox Offset != Forward)
tiers.note: Recomputes activations during backward using a different Philox RNG offset than forward -> corrupted gradients (34.8% error) & loss divergence!

tiers.name: Single Unseparated RNG Seed Across `TP=8` Ranks (Identical Attention Dropout / Desynced SP)
tiers.note: Replicated LayerNorm/Residual dropout uses different RNG across TP ranks (desyncing activations), or attention heads share identical correlated masks!

tiers.name: Legacy Host `torch.cuda.get_rng_state()` / `set_rng_state()` ByteTensor Copy Every Layer
tiers.note: Restores 100% forward-backward RNG match, but 160 host-device RNG state transfers per step break CUDAGraph capture and add 38.0ms overhead!

tiers.name: Dual-State `TensorParallelRNGTracker` (`DP-Synced` vs `TP-Sharded`) + CUDAGraph-Safe Device `Philox (seed, offset)`
tiers.note: Separates TP-replicated vs TP-sharded RNG streams and passes 16-byte Philox (seed, offset) directly into FlashAttention/FP8 kernels (0.4ms overhead, 100% exact)!
